value: The newly joined blade travels to the Crucible of Souls, deep within the Forge of Souls. There it is tempered amid the machinery of the Lich King’s frozen halls. The glowing furnace is an interpretive setting for a named quest step, not a measured reconstruction of the dungeon room. The work succeeds in shaping the weapon, yet the next chamber reveals that a finished edge and a clean spirit are not the same thing.
editorNote: Original paraphrase for research status. Check quest sequence, faction branch and setting against the original 3.3.5a client before lore approval. Randomized gameplay or mutually exclusive branches do not assert a unique canonical adventurer.
